pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge — LUMPI Track

Update — Due to increased interest from multiple qualified participants, Letters of Intent are now accepted through October 30, 2026, 8:00 PM EDT, aligned with the close of the development phase. Teams that have already submitted an LOI by email need take no further action. Teams joining now can register via our Letter of Intent Form.

Update — the Letter of Intent deadline is extended to August 15, 2026 (previously July 25). All other dates are unchanged.

A track of the 2026 IEEE Big Data Cup, held in conjunction with the IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData) 2026, Phoenix, AZ, USA.

Roadside LiDAR perception for intelligent transportation systems is bottlenecked by the cost and rarity of large, well-annotated real datasets. This challenge asks: can synthetic LiDAR data be made realistic enough that a deep learning model trained on it generalizes to real LiDAR frames?

Towards that, this challenge asks participants to generate their own synthetic LiDAR data targeting the LUMPI distribution, train an object detector on that data, and submit detections on real held-out frames. We score on (1) how distributionally close their synthetic frames are to real ones, and (2) how well the sim-only detector performs on real frames.

Important Dates

  • Letter of Intent Deadline: August 15, 2026 (extended from July 25)
  • Final Report and Solution Submission Deadline: November 15, 2026
  • Winning Teams Announcement: November 25, 2026
  • Conference: December 14–17, 2026

Reference resources for participants

To support participants who would like a documented starting point, we make publicly available a complete reference pipeline covering synthesis methodology, empirical analysis, ready-to-use synthetic datasets, and an open-source LiDAR data processing and visualization software. These materials are offered as orientation, not as requirements.

The synthesis pipeline is described in UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation (arXiv preprint), with a deeper empirical analysis including the distributional realism metrics adopted by this challenge in High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception (IEEE T-ITS, 2026).

The synthetic LiDAR datasets generated with that pipeline are released in UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets (IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026) and are available for download at Harvard Dataverse. Each dataset contains 10K frames annotated across six object categories for detection, tracking, and segmentation tasks, and is directly compatible with the multi-class evaluation used here; empirical analysis in papers include both the distributional realism metrics and single-class 3D object detection study as proof-of-concept. For end-to-end LiDAR processing we also provide our LiGuard Framework (IEEE T-IV, 2026) with short, more software focused read on The Journal of Open Source Software.

What you will do

  1. Download the public real LUMPI dataset and the released detection-test point clouds (50 real frames, no labels).
  2. Generate synthetic LiDAR frames using any approach you like — simulation (CARLA, LGSVL, custom), generative models (diffusion, GANs, flow-based), hybrid pipelines, or anything else.
  3. Train a 3D object detector (any architecture) on only your synthetic data.
  4. Submit:
    • 50 of your synthetic LiDAR frames,
    • your detector's predictions on the 50 released test point clouds,
    • and a signed honor declaration.

Scoring at a glance

Combined score = 0.6 × normalized 3D mAP + 0.4 × normalized realism, where 3D mAP is averaged across the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown) and realism averages normalized Chamfer Distance, MMD, EMD, and Fréchet Point-cloud Distance. See the Evaluation tab for the formulae.

Prizes

Per track:

  • 1st place: USD 500
  • 2nd place: USD 300
  • 3rd place: USD 200

Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Phases

  • Development — public leaderboard, up to 5 submissions/day per participant, 100 total. Use this to iterate.
  • Final — private leaderboard until close, 5 total submissions per participant. The final-phase ranking determines the winners.

Baselines

Reference numbers are listed in the Data tab.

# UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR挑战赛 — LUMPI赛道

更新 — 由于多个合格参赛者的兴趣增加，意向书现在接受至2026年10月30日晚8:00 EDT，与开发阶段结束相一致。已通过电子邮件提交意向书的团队无需采取进一步行动。新加入的团队可通过我们的意向书表格注册。

更新 — 意向书截止日期延长至2026年8月15日（原定7月25日）。所有其他日期保持不变。

2026年IEEE大数据杯的一个赛道，与IEEE国际大数据会议（IEEE BigData）2026年、美国亚利桑那州凤凰城联合举办。

路侧激光雷达感知在智能交通系统中的发展受到大规模、标注完善的真实数据集的成本和稀缺性的限制。本挑战提出的问题是：合成激光雷达数据是否足够真实，使得在其上训练的深度学习模型能够泛化到真实激光雷达帧？

为此，本挑战要求参赛者生成针对LUMPI分布的合成激光雷达数据，基于该数据训练目标检测器，并在真实的保留测试帧上提交检测结果。评分基于：（1）其合成帧与真实帧的分布接近程度，以及（2）仅在合成数据上训练的检测器在真实帧上的性能。

重要日期

  • 意向书截止日期： 2026年8月15日（从7月25日延长）
  • 最终报告和解决方案提交截止日期： 2026年11月15日
  • 获胜团队公布： 2026年11月25日
  • 会议： 2026年12月14-17日

参赛者参考资源

为支持寻求文档化起点的参赛者，我们公开提供完整的参考管道，涵盖合成方法论、经验分析、现成可用的合成数据集，以及开源激光雷达数据处理和可视化软件。这些材料作为参考方向提供，不是必需要求。

合成管道在UrbanTwin：为Sim2Real激光雷达感知和评估构建高保真数字孪生体（arXiv预印本）中描述，更深入的经验分析（包括本挑战采用的分布现实性指标）在为弥合基于激光雷达的ITS感知中Sim2Real差距的高保真数字孪生体（IEEE T-ITS，2026）中介绍。

使用该管道生成的合成激光雷达数据集在UrbanTwin：合成路侧激光雷达数据集（IEEE OJ-ITS，2026）中发布，可从Harvard Dataverse下载。每个数据集包含10K帧，跨越六个目标类别标注，用于检测、跟踪和分割任务，并直接兼容此处使用的多类评估；论文中的经验分析包括分布现实性指标和单类三维目标检测研究作为概念验证。为实现端到端激光雷达处理，我们还提供LiGuard框架（IEEE T-IV，2026）及相关内容。

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
Evaluation Protocol

Two scores are computed and combined into a single Combined score that determines leaderboard rank.

1. Distributional realism

Aggregation:

  1. Concatenate the 50 submitted synthetic frames into one set S_syn; concatenate the 50 held-out real reference frames into S_real.
  2. Mask both to the point-cloud range [-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5].
  3. Subsample uniformly at random to N = 10,000 points per side, with seed 1234 (identical seed used by the local evaluator in the starter kit).
  4. Compute one CD, MMD, EMD, and FPD across the entire 10,000-point sets.

1a. Chamfer Distance (CD)

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

Squared-L2 nearest-neighbor cost; symmetric. Lower is better.

1b. Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

Unbiased estimator (off-diagonal). Bandwidth γ is set by the median heuristic on a 1 000-point joint subsample (γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)) so the kernel does not saturate at LiDAR spatial scales. Lower is better.

1c. Earth Mover's Distance (EMD)

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1 with Euclidean ground cost, solved exactly by the network simplex (POT's ot.emd2). Reported in metres. Lower is better.

1d. Fréchet Point-cloud Distance (FPD)

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID-style: fits a 3-variate Gaussian to each set's points, computes the 2-Wasserstein between Gaussians. Lower is better.

2. 3D Object Detection

Participants submit detections (predictions.json) on 50 real LiDAR frames whose ground truth is held out. We compute average precision over the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown), at IoU thresholds 0.5 (primary) and 0.7 (secondary). Per-class AP is reported, and mean AP across classes (mAP) is the leaderboard's detection score; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out set are excluded from the mean. Both KITTI 11-point and 40-point interpolated AP are reported; the 40-point form is the leaderboard primary.

Ground-truth and predicted boxes use the OpenPCDet 7-DoF format [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]. IoU is computed as 3D intersection-over-union between two oriented BEV rectangles times the Z overlap. The KITTI truncation/occlusion/min-height difficulty filter is not applied because those depend on 2D bounding-box annotations that are not natural for roadside LiDAR datasets.

The valid class strings for this track are listed in config.json (shipped in reference_data/) and in submission_format.md in the starter kit. Any prediction with an unrecognized class label is discarded.

3. Combined score

Each component is min-max normalized into [0, 1] using a per-track normalization range:

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (lower-is-better → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (higher-is-better → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

Normalization endpoints are public in config.json (shipped in reference_data/), so the local evaluator and the server compute identical scores.

Reproducibility

  • Realism is dataset-level — frame ordering does not matter. Submit the 50 synthetic frames in any consistent naming.
  • Subsampling RNG seed: 1234 (same on server and starting kit).
  • The exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker is included in the starting kit.
pages.content_zh:
评估协议

计算两个分数并将其合并为单一的综合分数，该分数确定排行榜排名。

1. 分布真实性

聚合：

  1. 将50个提交的合成帧连接成一个集合S_syn；将50个保留的真实参考帧连接成S_real。
  2. 将两者都掩蔽到点云范围[-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5]。
  3. 以种子1234均匀随机下采样至每侧N = 10,000个点（与启动工具包中的本地评估器使用的种子相同）。
  4. 在整个10,000点集合中计算一个 CD、MMD、EMD和FPD。

1a. 倒角距离（CD）

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

平方L2最近邻成本；对称。越低越好。

1b. 最大均值差异（MMD）

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

无偏估计（非对角线）。带宽γ由1,000点联合子样本的中位数启发式设置（γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)），以便内核在激光雷达空间尺度下不会饱和。越低越好。

1c. 地球搬运距离（EMD）

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

欧几里得地面成本的Wasserstein-1，由网络单纯形精确求解（POT的ot.emd2）。以米为单位报告。越低越好。

1d. 弗雷歇点云距离（FPD）

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID风格：为每个集合的点拟合一个3元高斯分布，计算高斯分布之间的2-Wasserstein距离。越低越好。

2. 3D物体检测

参与者在50个真实激光雷达帧上提交检测（predictions.json），这些帧的真实值被保留。我们在本赛道定义的8个物体类别（行人、汽车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、货车、未知）上计算平均精度，IoU阈值为0.5（主要）和0.7（次要）。报告按类AP，类间平均AP（mAP）为排行榜检测分数；保留集中真实实例为零的类被排除在均值外。报告KITTI 11点和40点插值AP；40点形式为排行榜主要形式。

真实值和预测框使用OpenPCDet 7自由度格式[x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]。IoU计算为两个有向BEV矩形的3D交并比乘以Z重叠。KITTI截断/遮挡/最小高度难度过滤器不适用，因为这些依赖于对路边激光雷达数据集不自然的2D边界框标注。

本赛道的有效类字符串列在config.json（在reference_data/中提供）和启动工具包中的submission_format.md中。任何具有无法识别的类标签的预测都被丢弃。

3. 综合分数

每个分量使用每个赛道的标准化范围被最小-最大标准化到[0, 1]：

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (越低越好 → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (越高越好 → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

标准化端点在config.json（在reference_data/中提供）中公开，因此本地评估器和服务器评估结果一致。

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
Data

LUMPI

Real LUMPI data is publicly available from its original release. We do not redistribute it. Participants must obtain the real dataset directly from its source under its own license.

  • Source: https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
  • License: see the source.

Released for participants

The starting kit (Files tab → starting_kit) contains:

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50 real LiDAR frames (point clouds only, no labels) on which you must run your detector and submit predictions.
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — the canonical list of frame IDs your predictions.json must cover, in order.
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100 frame IDs you may not train, validate, or hyperparameter-tune on. This is the union of the 50 detection-test frames and the 50 realism-reference frames. Honor system, enforced by signed declaration in your submission.
  • local_eval.py — the exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker. Run it locally to reproduce server scores bit-for-bit, given a dummy reference set you generate from the released detection-test frames.
  • make_dummy_submission.py — produces a known-bad submission that exercises the format. Useful for sanity-checking your pipeline.
  • submission_format.md — full submission spec.

Held out (organizer-only)

  • 50 real frames used as the realism reference set.
  • Ground-truth boxes for the 50 detection-test frames.

Categories evaluated

This track is scored on 8 object categories defined for the LUMPI dataset: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across these categories; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out 50-frame set are excluded from the mean.

Splits

Splits are stratified random samples with fixed seed 1234. The exact frame ID lists are published in the starting kit so anyone can reproduce them from the released real dataset.

Reference baselines

The numbers below are reported for the Car class only, taken from prior work on this dataset. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across all categories defined for this track (see Evaluation), so submissions are scored on broader coverage than these single-class references. The baselines are included to demonstrate that sim → real transfer is achievable on this benchmark and to provide a per-class reference point for orientation while you iterate.

SystemCar 3D AP @ 0.5Car 3D AP @ 0.7
SEED (real LUMPI training, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4270 n/r
SEED (UT-LUMPI synthetic → real LUMPI, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4474 n/r
pages.content_zh:
# 数据

## LUMPI

实际**LUMPI**数据可从其原始发布来源公开获取。我们不重新分发这些数据。参与者必须根据其许可证直接从来源获得真实数据集。

- **来源：** https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
- **许可证：** 见上述来源。

## 为参与者发布的内容

起始工具包（*Files*标签 → starting_kit）包含：

- `detection_test_frames/` — **50个真实激光雷达帧**（仅点云，无标签），您必须在这些帧上运行检测器并提交预测。
- `detection_test_frame_ids.json` — 您的`predictions.json`必须按顺序覆盖的规范帧ID列表。
- `forbidden_frames.txt` — **100个帧ID，您不得在其上进行训练、验证或超参数调整**。这是50个检测测试帧和50个真实性参考帧的并集。基于荣誉制，由提交时的签署声明强制执行。
- `local_eval.py` — 与Codabench工作程序相同的评分程序。在本地运行以复现服务器分数（精确到比特），给定从发布的检测测试帧生成的虚拟参考集。
- `make_dummy_submission.py` — 生成已知的无效提交来演示格式。对于检查您的流程很有用。
- `submission_format.md` — 完整提交规范。

## 保留的内容（仅组织方）

- 用作**真实性参考集**的50个真实帧。
- 50个检测测试帧的真值框。

## 评估的类别

此赛道基于为**LUMPI**数据集定义的**8**个对象类别进行评分：
*Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown*。排行榜的检测分数是这些类别的平均AP；在保留的50帧集中没有真值实例的类被排除在平均值之外。

## 数据划分

数据划分是使用固定种子1234进行的分层随机采样。确切的帧ID列表已在起始工具包中发布，任何人都可以从发布的真实数据集中复现这些分割。

## 参考基线

下面的数字仅针对*Car*类别报告，取自该数据集上的先前工作。排行榜的检测分数是此赛道定义的所有类别的平均AP（见**评估**），因此提交的评分覆盖范围比这些单类参考更广。包含这些基线是为了演示sim → real迁移在此基准上是可行的，并为您迭代时提供单类参考点以便定向。

| 系统 | Car 3D AP @ 0.5 | Car 3D AP @ 0.7 |
|------|-----------------|-----------------|
| SEED（真实LUMPI训练，IEEE T-ITS 2026） | 0.4270 | n/r |
| SEED（UT-LUMPI合成 → 真实LUMPI，IEEE T-ITS 2026） | 0.4474 | n/r |

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
Submission Format

Pack everything below into a single submission.zip and upload it on the Submit tab.

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # exactly 50 files
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # signed honor declaration (PDF). declaration.txt also accepted.

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • Exactly 50 files.
  • Each file is raw float32, shape N × 3, in row-major order, with channels (x, y, z) in metres.
  • Either N × 3 or N × 4 (xyz + intensity) is accepted; the intensity column, if present, is dropped before scoring.
  • Each file ≤ 1.5 MB on disk (~125,000 points). Realism is computed at the dataset level: all 50 frames are concatenated, masked to the track's point-cloud range, then subsampled to 10,000 points (seed 1234) before computing CD / MMD / EMD / FPD. Submitting denser frames does not improve scores; frame ordering does not matter.
  • The simplest valid naming is 0001.bin … 0050.bin.

predictions.json

JSON object whose keys are the frame IDs from detection_test_frame_ids.json (in the starting kit). For every frame ID you must include an entry, even if the value is an empty list.

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box: 7 floats, OpenPCDet convention. (x, y, z) is the box center in metres in the LiDAR frame, (dx, dy, dz) are full extents along the box-local axes, heading is rotation around +Z in radians.
  • score: confidence in [0, 1].
  • class: one of the valid class strings for this track. Valid values: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. Class strings are matched case-insensitively. Predictions with unrecognized class strings are discarded before AP is computed.

declaration.pdf (or declaration.txt)

The starter kit ships declaration_template.pdf, a one-page form with the required honor statement preprinted and a signature line. Fill in team name and date, sign (digitally with any PDF tool, or print → sign → scan), save as declaration.pdf, and include it in every submission.

If you cannot easily produce a signed PDF, a plain declaration.txt is also accepted. Required statement (verbatim, case-insensitive):

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

What gets returned

After scoring (typically < 5 minutes for valid submissions) you'll see your position on the leaderboard plus a Detailed Results view with all component metrics, including per-class AP.
pages.content_zh:
# 提交格式

将以下所有内容打包到单个 submission.zip 文件中，并在"提交"选项卡上上传。

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # 恰好50个文件
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # 签署的诚信声明（PDF）。也接受 declaration.txt。

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • 恰好 50 个文件。
  • 每个文件均为原始 float32 格式，形状为 N × 3，行主序存储，通道为 (x, y, z)（单位：米）。
  • 接受 N × 3 或 N × 4（xyz + 强度）格式；如果存在强度列，则在评分前将其删除。
  • 每个文件磁盘空间 ≤ 1.5 MB（约125,000个点）。真实度评估在数据集级别进行：将所有50帧连接，掩蔽到轨迹点云范围，然后子采样到10,000个点（种子1234）后计算 CD / MMD / EMD / FPD。提交更密集的帧不会改善分数；帧顺序无关。
  • 最简单的有效命名方式是 0001.bin … 0050.bin。

predictions.json

JSON对象，其键为来自 detection_test_frame_ids.json（在初始工具包中）的帧ID。对于每个帧ID，您必须包含一个条目，即使该值为空列表。

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box：7个浮点数，遵循 OpenPCDet 约定。(x, y, z) 是LiDAR框架中的框 中心（单位：米），(dx, dy, dz) 是沿框局部轴的完整范围，heading 是绕 +Z 的旋转角度（单位：弧度）。
  • score：置信度范围 [0, 1]。
  • class：该轨迹的有效类别字符串之一。有效值：Person、Car、Bicycle、Motorcycle、Bus、Truck、Van、Unknown。类别字符串匹配不区分大小写。计算AP前，具有无法识别类别字符串的预测将被丢弃。

declaration.pdf（或 declaration.txt）

初始工具包中提供 declaration_template.pdf，这是一份单页表格，预印了必需的诚信声明和签名行。填写团队名称和日期，签名（使用任何PDF工具进行数字签名，或打印 → 签名 → 扫描），另存为 declaration.pdf，并将其包含在每次提交中。

如果您无法轻松生成签署的PDF，也接受纯文本 declaration.txt。必需声明（逐字，不区分大小写）：

我确认我没有针对 forbidden_frames.txt 中列出的任何帧进行训练，并且所有提交的检测都由仅在我生成的合成数据上训练的模型产生。

返回结果

评分后（对于有效提交通常少于5分钟），您将在排行榜上看到您的位置，以及包含所有组件指标的 详细结果 视图，包括按类别的AP。

pages.title: Rules
pages.content:
Rules

Eligibility

  • Open to anyone — researchers, students, industry teams.
  • Each team must register one participant account; do not maintain multiple accounts.

Allowed

  • Any simulation framework or generative model (CARLA, Helios++, OpenScene, neural radiance fields, diffusion, GANs, custom physics). Open or closed source — what matters is the synthesized data.
  • Any 3D object detector architecture, trained on your synthetic data only.
  • Augmentations applied during detector training (rotation, scale, flip, ground-truth sampling, noise) — they operate on synthetic data, not on the forbidden real frames.
  • Using the train split of the public real dataset for hyperparameter selection or domain adaptation, provided no forbidden frame is touched. (The forbidden list contains only the 100 reserved frames, not the entire real train split.)

Forbidden

  • Training, validating, hyperparameter-tuning, or otherwise observing ground truth from any of the 100 frames listed in forbidden_frames.txt. This is enforced by signed declaration and is the foundational integrity rule of the challenge.
  • Submitting predictions produced by a model that has been trained on real labels for any roadside-LiDAR dataset. The detector must be sim-only.
  • Reverse-engineering or inferring the held-out realism reference frames via Codabench's leaderboard signal (e.g., probing submissions designed to leak the reference set's identity). Submissions found to be doing this will be disqualified.
  • Multiple accounts, sub-team accounts, or coordinating across registered teams.

Disqualification

Organizers reserve the right to inspect the synthetic frames and predictions of any submission for evidence of forbidden-frame leakage (e.g., synthetic frames that suspiciously resemble held-out real frames; predictions whose distribution implies access to held-out ground truth). Disqualified participants are removed from the leaderboard and from prize consideration.

Prizes

Per track: 1st place USD 500, 2nd place USD 300, 3rd place USD 200. Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Publication and credit

  • Every participating team submits a 4–8 page challenge report describing their approach, due by the final-phase deadline (November 15, 2026).
  • Teams that prefer not to publish may opt into the non-publication track for their submission.
  • Top-3 teams per track are invited to present at the IEEE BigData 2026 Big Data Cup workshop session in Phoenix, AZ (December 14–17, 2026), and to submit a full paper to the IEEE BigData 2026 proceedings through the challenge's associated paper track.
  • The challenge organizers may publish an aggregate analysis of all submissions (anonymized unless explicit permission is granted).
pages.content_zh:
规则

资格条件

  • 对所有人开放——研究人员、学生、行业团队。
  • 每支团队必须注册一个参与者账户；不得维护多个账户。

允许的内容

  • 任何仿真框架或生成模型（CARLA、Helios++、OpenScene、神经辐射场、扩散模型、GAN、自定义物理引擎）。开源或闭源——重要的是合成数据。
  • 任何3D目标检测器架构，仅在你的合成数据上训练。
  • 检测器训练期间应用的增强方法（旋转、缩放、翻转、真值采样、噪声）——它们作用于合成数据，而不是禁止的真实帧。
  • 使用公共真实数据集的训练集分割进行超参数选择或域适配，前提是不触及任何禁止帧。（禁止列表仅包含100个保留帧，不包含整个真实训练集分割。）

禁止的内容

  • 从forbidden_frames.txt中列出的100个帧中的任何帧进行训练、验证、超参数调整或以其他方式观察真值。这由签名声明强制执行，是该挑战的基础完整性规则。
  • 提交由在任何路侧激光雷达数据集的真实标签上训练的模型产生的预测。检测器必须仅基于仿真训练。
  • 通过Codabench排行榜信号反向工程或推断保留的真实性参考帧（例如，探测设计用于泄露参考集身份的提交）。发现进行此操作的提交将被取消资格。
  • 多个账户、子团队账户或跨注册团队的协调。

取消资格

组织者保留权利对任何提交的合成帧和预测进行检查，以查证是否存在禁止帧泄露证据（例如，与保留真实帧可疑相似的合成帧；其分布意味着访问了保留真值的预测）。被取消资格的参与者将从排行榜和奖项考虑中删除。

奖项

每个赛道：第一名USD 500、第二名USD 300、第三名USD 200。赞助商将在开发阶段开始前宣布。

发表和署名

  • 每支参赛队伍提交一份4-8页的挑战报告，描述其方法，截止日期为最终阶段截止日期（2026年11月15日）。
  • 倾向于不发表的团队可选择加入其提交的非发表赛道。
  • 每个赛道的前3名团队受邀在亚利桑那州凤凰城的IEEE BigData 2026大数据杯研讨会会议上进行报告（2026年12月14-17日），并通过挑战的相关论文赛道向IEEE BigData 2026会议论文集提交完整论文。
  • 挑战组织者可发布所有提交的汇总分析（匿名，除非获得明确许可）。
